intent: has() presence test over an optional attribute.

plannerDivergence.issue: Cerbos planner folds has(unknown attribute) to KIND_ALWAYS_ALLOWED
plannerDivergence.reason: The planner folds has(unknown attr) to KIND_ALWAYS_ALLOWED (a Cerbos planner bug, not an adapter bug), so the adapter returns all rows while check() denies rows where the attribute is missing.

trap: has() must become a presence (IS NOT NULL) test; the planner currently folds it to always-allowed, so adapters return every row while check() denies rows missing the attribute.
